source.table: Garr Tool Milling Guide, printed technical page 300 (X3) - Chipload per tooth (Fz) by diameter
source.cells: 13/8, 15/5, 17-4, pH Types col 1/32", < 40 HRC: SFM 290 - 490; Fz .0001 - .0003 in/tooth; Profile/Trochoidal Milling: ap MAX (= flute length of part); ae Up to 15% Dia.

vendor_notes: Above are starting parameters only. Higher results may be achieved with optimum conditions.
Data does not reflect chip thinning.
Spindle interface must be scrutinized when using 5/8" diameter and larger end mills.
Sheet legend (Profile/Trochoidal Milling): Axial (ap) MAX (= flute length of part); Radial (ae) Up to 15% Dia..
Material label "13/8" is printed that way on the sheet (13-8 PH).
rows.notes: Part chosen as a standard-length square-end part of the series at this diameter (first/standard listing at the catalog page); Garr prints one chip-load chart for the whole series and one ap/ae legend; chart read from pdftotext and checked against rendered technical page (300). Operation is the sheet's only milling mode, labelled "Profile/Trochoidal Milling". ap/ae in inches computed from the printed form; where a range is printed ("MAX (= flute length of part)" / "Up to 15% Dia.") the upper bound is recorded in cut.ap/cut.ae and the printed range is kept in cut.published. G-coated part number (AlTiSiN) chosen because Garr targets G-series at heat-resistant alloys / PH stainless / conditioned tool steels; the chart is shared by the X and G parts.
